name: @pipeworx/mcp-clickup

tools.name: clickup_list_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks in a ClickUp list. Returns task ID, name, status, priority, assignees, due date, and URL. Provide list ID (e.g., "123456").

list_id.description: List ID to fetch tasks from

tools.name: clickup_get_task
tools.description: Fetch full task details including name, description, status, priority, assignees, tags, and time tracking. Provide task ID (e.g., "9hz6c").

tools.name: clickup_create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a ClickUp list. Provide list ID, task name, and optionally priority and assignee. Returns task ID, name, status, and URL.

list_id.description: List ID to create the task in

due_date.description: Due date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds

tools.name: clickup_list_spaces
tools.description: List all spaces in your ClickUp workspace. Returns space ID, name, and status.

tools.name: clickup_list_folders
tools.description: List all folders in a ClickUp space. Provide space ID (e.g., "789"). Returns folder ID, name, and list count.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-clickup forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the clickup pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
